title: Enable TypeScript Strict Mode
description: Enable TypeScript strict mode across tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json before feature code is written, per AGENTS.md zero-tolerance-for-any policy.
spec:
1. Verify tsconfig.app.json compilerOptions sets "strict": true
2. Verify tsconfig.node.json compilerOptions sets "strict": true
3. Verify existing noUnusedLocals / noUnusedParameters / noFallthroughCasesInSwitch options are retained (not removed)
4. Verify `bun run build` (tsc -b && vite build) still passes with strict enabled
5. Verify no `any` types or `@ts-expect-error`/`@ts-ignore` were introduced to force the build green
6. Rationale: AGENTS.md mandates zero tolerance for `any`; enabling strict before any board/column/card code is authored ensures type safety from the first line rather than retrofitting later
notes: Added "strict": true to compilerOptions in both tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json, preserving the existing noUnusedLocals / noUnusedParameters / noFallthroughCasesInSwitch options. `bun run smoke:qc` (typecheck + lint + tsc -b && vite build + format:check) passes clean with strict enabled; no `any`, `@ts-expect-error`, or `@ts-ignore` were introduced to force the build green.
